Place your finger over the phone LED and camera and try to match the PPG Wave shown below:
• Try adjusting how you hold your phone to get a better signal
• Try adjusting pressure to see what gives the best results
• Line should be smooth without sharp jumps

Data isn't always perfect, the images below is quite noisy containing sharp points on the curve, or jumps where the app couldn't read the PPG:
• Some phones simply record better data than others
• The system is made to handle dips and bumps
• The core thing is that your recordings are consistent between sessions
